name: PicClick/eBay price-refresh scrape Dec-2026 (cron)
notes: Cron price-refresh pass over PicClick (working eBay mirror; ebay.com direct and DDG lite are antibot'd). Captures Dec-2026 asking-price deltas vs the Oct-2026 baselines for RTX 3090, MI100, Mac Studio M1 Ultra 128GB and M3 Ultra 96GB. Other parts (V100, A100, MI210/250, Gaudi2, P40/M40/P100, Arc B580/B60/B70, 9070XT, 7900XTX, Strix Halo boxes, EPYC+DDR5, DGX-1, M4 Max) were NOT refreshed - scraper throttled.
